description: Assemble a model card from a model config and its metrics, and flag missing governance sections. When a model needs documentation for governance or release. Do not choose this when you need the model evaluated, which needs the model and data. Example requests: Generate a model card from this config and these metrics. | Document this model for governance review. | Build a model card for my classifier.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

config.description: The customer's config.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The model configuration. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

metrics.description: The customer's metrics.json, as text. Supported: JSON. Evaluation metrics. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_model_card_generator
title: Model card generator
